Each time an agent stops, the hub has the triage model read its last reply (once per turn) and notes in the list what it finished or what it\'s waiting for. Finished ones no longer count as Unread.

After a temporary model service error (503 and the like), it sends “continue” up to 3 times; an agent waiting on a deploy, CI or another agent is woken on time to check for itself. Both run another turn of the agent on its own model. Pushing code, deploying or messaging others: the hub only asks you, it never does these on its own.

When an agent stops after doing work without saying whether it\'s done, merged and deployed, and what\'s missing, its stop is held once to ask for that record. Costs one short extra turn on the agent\'s model

When an agent that nobody supervises stops after doing work, without a closeout and without being clearly finished, Persona asks it once for a status report on the work already done. Costs one turn on the agent\'s model
When an agent asked you something and you looked but haven\'t replied for 30 minutes, you\'re reminded once. Rules only, no tokens spent.
